scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const file of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.rmSync(file,{force:true}); } catch {} } const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/moodsic run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/moodsic run build
